title: Stealth Classic Thief: The Dark Project Returns for a PS5 Remaster with New Content
summary:
Out on PS5 from 3rd December 2026.

One of the classics that helped create an entire genre, stealth masterpiece Thief: The Dark Project is coming to PS5 in remastered form next month, from 3rd December 2026.

This new version of the 1998 game has been remastered using Nightdive Studios' KEX Engine to produce a new edition running at 4K and 120 frames-per-second. It's got all the content of the base game, the three extra missions from Thief: Gold, and an entirely new campaign in the form of The Tarnished Mirror.

title: Yakuza Creator's Gang of Dragon PS5 Game and New Studio Officially Dead
summary:
Dissolved days ago on 31st October.

Gang of Dragon, the Yakuza-esque title Toshiro Nagoshi planned to make with a newly set-up developer under NetEase, will never see the light of day. Nagoshi Studio has now officially been closed, as of 31st October 2026.

This news had been expected for some time, as reports dating back to March 2026 detail publisher NetEase pulling its funding. The game had only been revealed a few months prior at The Game Awards. Now we know for sure the studio and PS5 game are both gone, as a notice has appeared in the Japanese government gazette Kanpo (via Gematsu).
